description: Render the NJ phylogeny with bootstrap support beside the PANTHER subfamily-by-clade distribution, and query WormBase/Alliance/ESTHER for independent annotation of abhd-14
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
P="/agent/jobs/4b88b03e-a581-4087-a81c-c6faa0ea4230/provenance/"
nwk=open(P+"nj_tree.newick").read().strip().rstrip(";")
bt=pd.read_csv(P+"table_6_nj_bootstrap_clades.csv")
supp={frozenset(r.clade.split(", ")):r.bootstrap_pct for r in bt.itertuples()}
ct=pd.read_csv(P+"table_5b_subfamily_clade_crosstab.csv",index_col=0)

# --- parse newick into nested tuples ---
def parse(s,i=0):
    ch=[]
    while i<len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if c=='(':
            sub,i=parse(s,i+1); ch.append(sub)
        elif c==')': return ch,i+1
        elif c==',': i+=1
        else:
            j=i
            while j<len(s) and s[j] not in '(),': j+=1
            ch.append(s[i:j]); i=j
    return ch,i
tree,_=parse(nwk,0); tree=tree[0]

def leaves(nd): return [nd] if isinstance(nd,str) else [l for c in nd for l in leaves(c)]
order=leaves(tree)
ypos={nm:k for k,nm in enumerate(order)}
COL={"A":"#1f77b4","B":"#d62728","SF3":"#2ca02c"}
def grp(nm):
    if "14A" in nm or "14a" in nm: return "A"
    if "14B" in nm: return "B"
    return "SF3"

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15,6.2))
ax=fig.add_subplot(1,2,1)
segs=[]
def draw(nd,x):
    if isinstance(nd,str):
        ax.plot([x,13],[ypos[nd]]*2,color="0.75",lw=0.7,ls=":")
        ax.text(13.2,ypos[nd],nd.replace("_"," "),va="center",fontsize=8.5,color=COL[grp(nd)])
        return ypos[nd]
    ys=[draw(c,x+1) for c in nd]
    ax.plot([x+1,x+1],[min(ys),max(ys)],color="0.2",lw=1.3)
    for y in ys: ax.plot([x,x+1],[y,y],color="0.2",lw=1.3)
    y=float(np.mean([min(ys),max(ys)]))
    ax.plot([x,x+1],[y,y],color="0.2",lw=1.3)
    s=supp.get(frozenset(leaves(nd)))
    if s is not None and len(leaves(nd))>1:
        ax.text(x+1.05,y+0.22,f"{s:.0f}",fontsize=7.5,color="#444")
    return y
draw(tree,0)
ax.set_xlim(0,21); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(order)-0.2); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Neighbour-joining tree, 16 PTHR46197 representatives\n210 alignment columns, 200 bootstrap replicates (cladogram, node numbers = bootstrap %)",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
for lab,c,yy in [("vertebrate ABHD14A","#1f77b4",0),("vertebrate ABHD14B","#d62728",1),("non-vertebrate SF3","#2ca02c",2)]:
    ax.text(0.3,len(order)-1.1-yy*0.75,lab,color=c,fontsize=8.5,weight="bold")
ax.annotate("Ce ABHD-14 sits outside the\nvertebrate A+B clade (bs 54.5),\ninside the nematode clade (bs 100)",
            xy=(13,ypos["Ce_ABHD-14"]),xytext=(2.0,ypos["Ce_ABHD-14"]-2.6),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#2ca02c",lw=1.1),color="#2ca02c")

ax2=fig.add_subplot(1,2,2)
ct2=ct.loc[[i for i in ct.index if ct.loc[i].sum()>=5]]
ct2=ct2.loc[ct2.sum(1).sort_values().index]
yv=np.arange(len(ct2)); h=0.27
for k,(c,col) in enumerate(zip(ct2.columns,["#1f77b4","#d62728","#2ca02c"])):
    ax2.barh(yv+(1-k)*h,ct2[c],height=h,color=col,label=c.split(":")[-1])
ax2.set_yticks(yv); ax2.set_yticklabels(ct2.index,fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_xscale("symlog"); ax2.set_xlabel("UniProt entries (symlog)",fontsize=9)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8,title="PANTHER subfamily",title_fontsize=8)
ax2.set_title("PTHR46197 subfamily by clade, 2347 UniProt entries\nSF1 and SF2 are 1754/1754 vertebrate; SF3 is 592/593 non-vertebrate\nFisher exact odds = inf, p < 1e-300",fontsize=9.5,loc="left")
ax2.grid(axis="x",alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# --- independent database checks ---
print("=== WormBase / Alliance check for abhd-14 (WBGene Y55F3AM.10) ===")
try:
    r=requests.get("https://www.alliancegenome.org/api/search",params={"q":"abhd-14","category":"gene","limit":10},timeout=60)
    hits=[(h.get("symbol"),h.get("species"),h.get("primaryKey")) for h in r.json().get("results",[])]
    print("Alliance search hits:",hits[:10])
except Exception as e: print("Alliance search failed:",repr(e))
for wb in ["WB:WBGene00021346"]:
    pass
try:
    r=requests.get("http://rest.wormbase.org/rest/field/gene/Y55F3AM.10/concise_description",timeout=60)
    print("WormBase concise_description:",json.dumps(r.json())[:600])
except Exception as e: print("WormBase REST failed:",repr(e))
print("\n=== ESTHER check ===")
try:
    r=requests.get("https://bioweb.supagro.inra.fr/ESTHER/gene_locus?name=caeel-Y55F3AM.10&class=Gene_locus",timeout=60)
    print("ESTHER HTTP",r.status_code,"len",len(r.text))
    import re as _re
    txt=_re.sub("<[^>]+>"," ",r.text); txt=_re.sub(r"\s+"," ",txt)
    print(txt[:900])
except Exception as e: print("ESTHER not reachable:",repr(e))
